query: For untargeted metabolomics and targeted PRM, what feature-filtering rules, normalization pipelines, discovery/validation split, and replication criteria will be applied?

response.query: For untargeted metabolomics and targeted PRM, what feature-filtering rules, normalization pipelines, discovery/validation split, and replication criteria will be applied?
response.answer: For untargeted metabolomics, feature filtering excludes low-intensity signals; targeted PRM uses peptide normalization. Discovery/validation split is 70/30; replication criteria include biological and technical replicates.
